```sql
WITH armstrong_area AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Armstrong' AND addr_state ILIKE 'Iowa'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM armstrong_area), true) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM armstrong_area))
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(ST_Count(rast, 1)) AS total_pixels,
    SUM(ST_Count(ST_Reclass(rast, 1, '0-60:0,60-:1', '8BUI'), 1)) AS above_60_pixels
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT
  ROUND((above_60_pixels * 100.0 / total_pixels)::numeric, 2) AS percent_above_60
FROM elevation_stats;
```
